statement: SDL declares gyroscope/accelerometer sensors in enhanced report mode and reports distinct nominal rates 250 Hz for USB and 1000 Hz for Bluetooth (source comments/metadata); this is a consumer declaration, not a measured physical sensor or USB scheduling rate.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, HHD adbd50f, virtualgamepad archive a5310c6; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_ps5.c 802-842. Do not treat declared rate as observed output or verify Steam motion association from these calls alone.
